newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Army captain in sex case imprisoned, dismissed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Army captain in sex case imprisoned, dismissed.

text.p: - A military judge Thursday sentenced Capt. Derrick Robertson, convicted of consensual sex with a female trainee, to three years in prison, dismissal from the service and forfeiture of all pay and allowance.
However, because of a prior plea agreement, the prison sentence was reduced to one year, with all but four months suspended. Robertson was also sentenced to six months' probation.
"Today, after six long months, the Army finally dropped those false charges against me," Robertson said after the verdict had been read.
"I pleaded guilty only to a consensual relationship, which is prohibited by military law," he added.

The government agreed to drop the charge of rape and all forcible sex allegations after an investigator found that an original report had embellished the alleged victim's statements, defence attorney Maj. Jerome Murphy said.
Murphy also accused Army officers of tainting Robertson's case by hastily and inaccurately accusing him of rape.
